name: require-js
description: Adds require.js AMD module goto definition support.

requireModuleSupport.configFile.description: Path of the RequireJS configuration file relative to workspace root

requireModuleSupport.enableCjsModules.description: Parse source files as pure CommonJS modules

requireModuleSupport.moduleCacheSize.description: Maximum count of parsed modules and their dependencies kept in memory as cache to improve performance

requireModuleSupport.includeModulePatter.description: File globbing pattern to find JavaScript modules in this project

requireModuleSupport.excludeModulePatter.description: File globbing pattern to exclude when looking for JavaScript modules in this project

requireModuleSupport.cutFileCompletionEx.description: File extensions to cut, if the file name is offered in module path completion

requireModuleSupport.includeFileCompleti.description: Only the specified file extensions will be included for module path completion; all will be included, if empty

requireModuleSupport.excludeFileCompleti.description: The specified file extensions will not be included for module path completion

requireModuleSupport.modulePath.description: Module path relative to workspace root

requireModuleSupport.onlyNavigateToFile.description: Should we search inside the landing file?

requireModuleSupport.pluginExtensions.description: Assigns default file extensions to target module paths used with RequireJS plugins

requireModuleSupport.moduleProcessingBat.description: How many documents should be opened and searched before cancelling of the operation is possible
